answer: Admission: a newcomer posts a 500-token bond to the grove registry and submits a crystal hash of its weights plus a signed fee bid. At epoch close, three validators drawn from the trellis routing table re-run the hash and cross-check the bid; a mismatch slashes the bond to the challenger. With per-seat epoch revenue R=400 below bond B=500, each cloned identity nets -100, so the sybil attack loses money.
